lines: Well. A cub from the loud hill, fallen out of the sky.
bear.d1.l1.speaker: burl

choices.text: Have you seen the blinking light?

lines: And cubs don't fly. Yet here we both are.
bear.d1.l3.speaker: burl

lines: Check my ears for brass, then. Gently.
bear.d1.a.l1.speaker: burl

lines: One. The blue ones are mine. They are all blue.
bear.d1.b.l1.speaker: burl

lines: Since my grandmother was a cub. It never tires.
bear.d1.c.l1.speaker: burl

lines: Go on, sky-cub. Walk soft. The wild is listening.
bear.d1.close.speaker: burl

lines: Back again? The berries are still mine. Mostly.
bear.repeat.speaker: burl
